lead_paragraph: This is a synthetic paper_info demonstrating every field the renderer accepts. Replace each field with content drawn from a real paper (paraphrased, not verbatim) when authoring a real learning guide.
meta_description: Synthetic demo paper_info used to exercise the paperlink_to_html renderer.

sections.title: What this example shows
sections.body_html:
This synthetic example exists so you can run render_html.py end-to-end without copying any real paper's content. Every section of a real paper_info JSON is represented here in miniature.

Tip. When writing a real paper_info, the body_html of each section is RAW HTML — drop in <p> paragraphs, <table>, <svg> illustrations, or any custom widget you need.
